notes.title: 2 years old and 2 presents for you!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36656086/1fe658d2264611553ed203f708d79919f7be125a.png[/img]

Hello, guys.

On January 17th Male Doll will complete 2 years old. After so many years trying to create a studio in which LGBTQ+ people (like me) could create games and live from their dreams, I finally got it. Today, we are a small team from Brazil working on games that we can relate to, especially when we are talking about products not based on visual mechanics and dating simulators.

We believe games are platforms to talk about diversity and differences and we work everyday to make other LGBTQ+ devs have the opportunity that we didn't have when we were kids.

However, this wouldn’t happen without each of you who have been supporting us every day and giving honest feedback about what we create. We really appreciate everyone who helped us directly and indirectly on this journey. Thank you!

To celebrate this moment, we have two presents for you!

First, we’ve started a raffle on [url=https://discord.gg/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] in which 2 people will receive a copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280640/Boyfriends_Rescue___Gay_Platform_Game]Boyfriend’s Rescue[/url], our main project from 2020! If you want to give it a shot, we’ll be glad to welcome you. Also, don’t forget to react to Giveaway Bot’s comment. This raffle ends on Monday 18th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280640/Boyfriends_Rescue___Gay_Platform_Game/

Second, our [url=https://www.redbubble.com/people/MaleDollStudio/]shop[/url] is now live! Yeaaah! You can check some products that we’ve made for you like bottoms, t-shirts, spiral notebooks and much more! Check it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36656086/b552e6839024a3988470fa73f245f73f775e2cdc.png[/img]

Thank you all for being with us and wishlist our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll/list/58737]upcoming release[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468430/Freezer_Pops

Don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam page[/url], [b]we are about to reach 300 followers![/b]

Cheers,

Victoria

Hello, everyone.

I would like to announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227600/Villain_Project/]Villain Project[/url] theme will be removed from the store. This DLC was a result of a partnership with Pablo Dias and an opportunity to check how our community welcomes it. However, it is time to focus on new things and I’ve decided to remove it. Thank you all for supporting this project as well as the composer.

Cheers,

Victoria

notes.title: Villain Project’s new mode is now available
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

After many feedback on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227600/Villain_Project/]Villain Project[/url], the team and I have decided to make an update for the game. Now, you’ll have a Free Mode which offers you the possibility of choosing a puzzle that will be available after you complete the Story Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36656086/a34dd51b3da2e6c435be9548203d3ae0e2b99f00.png[/img]

This mode allows you to divide all puzzles into difficulties levels from 1 to 6 divisions to create your own difficulty. Also, you can activate a time limit to try to complete the puzzle in less than two minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36656086/77320c74a2f47e098f4c74d2368db5df85dde9ed.png[/img]

Last but not least, you can hide the puzzle guide in both modes to make the game even more challenging!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36656086/d9321f396a13b7213656bf34556ab24935288122.png[/img]

Thank you all for the feedback, the team and I are working really hard to deliver you in August [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280640/Boyfriends_Rescue___Gay_Platform_Game/]Boyfriend’s Rescue[/url], an amazing gay platform game.

Thank you so much for supporting my work, I hope you all enjoy the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll/list/62178]Male Doll’s Summer Sale 2020[/url] and I hope you like my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll/list/58737]upcoming releases[/url].

notes.title: A Free Mode is coming + Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

[b]I’m so excited to announce this Friday, July 3rd, a Free Mode will be available for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227600/Villain_Project/]Villain Project[/url].[/b]

This mode was created because of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/AstralZenith/recommended/1227600/]Astral Zenith’s feedback[/url] on Steam and it consists on you being able to select a range (1 to 6) to define how many pieces the puzzle will be divided into. Also, since this mode will be unlocked after you complete the ‘Story Mode’, you’ll be able to choose which puzzle you want to play. Check the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36656086/27e582a873e635b5cc1c3443e00f2d9e99577e1b.png[/img]

As you can see in the image, there is a new option to make this mode more challenging: a ‘time limit’. If you turn it on, you can play a puzzle using the range of divisions you chose before you run out of time. If you can’t do that in less than 2 minutes, you’ll lose the game. New achievements will be available for this specific mode.

Last but not least, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/pride_fk/recommended/1227600/]Mr. HBO[/url] suggests the game could be more interesting by hiding the puzzle guide, so let’s do it! Now, you’ll be able to play the Story Mode or the Free Mode with or without the puzzle guide! Check this feature below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36656086/0a740fd4be123e486014af2b4275eaa7dff27b8a.png[/img]

As I’ve said, this update will be implemented on July 3rd so if you haven’t bought the game yet, it’s time to do it!

Cheers,

Victoria

notes.title: An meine deutschen Spieler: Bitte lesen!
notes.notes:
Hallo meine Lieben,

Es ist nun schon ein Jahr her, seit ich angefangen habe vollzeitlich Spiele zu produzieren. Bis hierher war es ein langer Weg, doch Dank Eurer Hilfe war es mir möglich in spannende Projekte zu investieren, die noch im Laufe dieses Jahres veröffentlicht werden. Ich weiß Euer ehrliches Feedback, welches Ihr mir stets sendet, sehr zu schätzen. Mir ist aber auch bewusst, dass die Sprache oft ein großes Hindernis darstellt, um uns einander näher zu bringen. Um dieses Hindernis zu überwinden, bat ich meine Community Mitglieder bei der Übersetzung meines ersten Erzählerischen Puzzlespiels namens Villain Project zu helfen. Viele von Euch wissen es vielleicht nicht, aber ich bin eine brasilianische Drag Queen, daher ist weder Englisch noch Deutsch meine Muttersprache. Deshalb möchte ich mich für die Hilfe bei der Übersetzung bedanken und hoffe, dass Ihr alle viel Spaß mit Villain Project habt.

Danke, für all Eure Unterstützung und macht Euch bereit, denn ein neues unterhaltsames Gay Game erscheint schon bald!

Liebe Grüße

Victoria

Vergesst nicht meiner Steam Gruppe beizutreten und schaut auch auf meinem Discord Server vorbei, um die Chance zu bekommen, meine Spiele vorab zu testen.
